cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Hold this bucket under the seascape. I'll get towels before the gallery floor floods. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is a painting leaking? I said we should buy a print.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You can choose the replacement. Tilt the bucket toward the waves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are there fish? This bucket's nearly full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fetch the aquarium from reception. I'll hold this one until you're back.

mechanism: A directs gallery cleanup and grants B replacement choice while transforming each why question about a leaking painting into a containment task.
confusable: Unlike merely denying a cause, A supplies the next useful action and takes over work to keep B helping.
comparison: Flooding artwork and fish containment differ from transporting a breakfast ghost.
seedUse: D158-b print objection, fish and aquarium; S02-b yields purchasing choice and holds the heavy bucket.
